There's some stuff here. Feel free to add more stuff. Anything from documentation, to ideas, to recommendations; just keep it _kinda_ related to the game.

When you have an idea, create an issue. Take pride in your idea and describe it so that others can understand it. Assign labels to your issues.

When you need a break from coming up with such great ideas, you can assign an issue to yourself. Make sure to track your progress on the issue.
